title: 211 Palmerstown Avenue, Palmerstown, Dublin 20, D20RK38
description:
Impressive Three-Bedroom Family Home with Large Private South-East Facing Rear Garden with No Onward Chain 
Michael O’Flaherty from LWK is delighted to present No. 211 Palmerstown Avenue to the market, an attractive and generously proportioned three-bedroom mid-terrace family home, ideally positioned on one of Palmerstown’s most established and sought-after residential avenues.

Extending to approximately 94 sq. m., this fine property offers bright, well-proportioned accommodation throughout, complemented by excellent private outdoor space and a highly convenient location. Presented in excellent condition, No. 211 is sure to appeal to first-time buyers, families and those seeking a comfortable home with excellent potential for further enhancement.

Key Features:

	Three-bedroom mid-terrace family home
	Approximately 94 sq. m.
	BER Rating: D
	Large private south-east facing rear garden
	Rear laneway access
	Off-street parking for several cars
	Two Barna sheds
	Potential to convert the attic, subject to the necessary planning requirements
	Gas-fired central heating
	Two generous reception rooms
	Fireplaces in both reception rooms
	Well-appointed kitchen with direct access to the rear garden
	Double-glazed windows
	Alarmed
	Excellent condition throughout
	Mature and highly sought-after residential location
	Excellent transport links
	Easy access to the M50 motorway
	Close to local shops, schools and amenities
	Phoenix Park within easy reach

On entering, a welcoming hallway leads to a comfortable front sitting room, while to the rear is a generous living/dining room, with both reception rooms benefiting from fireplaces that add warmth and character to the accommodation. A well-appointed kitchen is located to the rear and provides direct access to the garden through patio doors. The property also benefits from double-glazed windows, an alarm system and gas-fired central heating.

Upstairs, there are three well-proportioned bedrooms together with a family bathroom. The bedrooms offer excellent versatility and provide ample space for modern family living. The attic also offers excellent potential for conversion, subject to the necessary planning and building requirements, providing an exciting opportunity for the new owner to further enhance the accommodation.

A particular highlight of No. 211 is the large, private south-east facing rear garden. Offering excellent natural light and a wonderful sense of privacy, the garden provides an ideal space for outdoor entertaining, relaxing and family use. There are also two Barna sheds, providing valuable additional storage. The property further benefits from laneway access, which are particularly useful and rarely available in properties of this type.

To the front, the property enjoys generous off-street parking for several cars, providing excellent convenience for residents and visitors alike.

The location is excellent, with Palmerstown Avenue offering a mature and highly regarded residential setting. A wide range of local amenities, including shops, cafés, schools and recreational facilities, are all within easy reach. The area is well served by frequent bus routes providing convenient access to Dublin City Centre and surrounding areas, while the M50 motorway is also easily accessible. The Phoenix Park is just minutes away by car.

Combining generous and well-balanced living accommodation, three excellent bedrooms, a large private south-east facing rear garden, garage, laneway access, generous off-street parking and excellent potential for future enhancement, No. 211 Palmerstown Avenue represents an excellent opportunity to acquire a quality family home in one of Palmerstown’s most established residential areas.

Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the generous accommodation, excellent outdoor space and superb potential this fine property has to offer.
